title: EventSSM: Causal Spatial-State Modelling for Asynchronous Events Event-Depth Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2611.31720v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Event cameras report asynchronous brightness changes, yet metric-depth supervision is typically available only at sparsely sampled reference timestamps. Aggregating events into frame-like representations simplifies learning but can obscure the fine-grained temporal structure of the original event stream. We introduce EventSSM, a causal spatial-state framework for event-associated metric-depth estimation using a recurrent memory updated by chronological event packets. To bridge asynchronous predictions and frame-time supervision, predicted event depths are geometrically transported using calibrated camera poses and differentiably rendered at reference timestamps. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate improvements over established event-depth methods across multiple depth-error measures. translated_title: EventSSM：面向异步事件深度估计的因果空间-状态建模
translated_abstract: 事件相机以异步方式记录亮度变化，而度量深度监督通常仅在稀疏采样的参考时间戳处可用。将事件聚合为类帧表示虽然简化了学习过程，但可能掩盖原始事件流的细粒度时间结构。我们提出了EventSSM，这是一个用于与事件相关联的度量深度估计的因果空间-状态框架，它采用由按时间顺序到达的事件数据包更新的循环记忆。为了连接异步预测与帧时刻监督，预测的事件深度利用标定的相机位姿进行几何传输，并在参考时间戳处进行可微渲染。基准评估表明，该方法在多个深度误差指标上均优于已有的事件深度方法。受控消融实验进一步考察了跨模态初始化、时间循环、个体状态、读出与监督组件以及事件数据包子采样等因素的作用。
tldr: 提出EventSSM——一种用循环记忆按时间顺序处理事件数据包的因果空间-状态模型，实现异步事件关联的度量深度估计，并通过相机位姿几何传输与可微渲染桥接异步预测与稀疏帧时刻监督，在多个深度误差指标上超越已有方法。
en_tdlr: EventSSM is a causal spatial-state model with recurrent memory that processes chronological event packets for asynchronous event-associated metric-depth estimation, bridging asynchronous predictions and frame-time supervision via pose-based geometric transport and differentiable rendering to outperform existing event-depth methods across multiple depth-error metrics.
